title: The Litani River Basin: under systematic environmental destruction
summary: The Lower Litani from the Beaufort side to Aalmane on Sentinel-2, October 2025 to October 2026: the ground the war changed, a year of land cover, and the river before the war.

marked.label: marked by Green Southerners on Sentinel-2, Oct 2025 to Oct 2026

steps.title: The Lower Litani basin
text: Ongoing Israeli military operations, land clearance and detonations threaten the Lower Litani basin, a 629 km² ecological and hydrological system spanning 131 municipalities and supporting irrigation for over 4,000 hectares of coastal farmland.
Here the river comes south past Deir Mimas, turns west under Beaufort Castle, Arnoun and Yohmor, and winds on past Zawtar and Aalmane.

steps.title: From the Beaufort side
text: Below Beaufort Castle, from Deir Mimas to Yohmor and Arnoun. Below the map the same ground is shown on Sentinel-2 passes of 21 October 2025 and 23 October 2026; the yellow boxes are the places Green Southerners marked on them.

steps.title: West, past Zawtar
text: Westward along the gorge, between Zawtar and Deir Siriane, on the same two passes.

steps.title: Aalmane
text: Closer, at Aalmane on the south bank: the green band of the valley floor, October 2025 and October 2026.

steps.title: A year of land cover
text: The resulting environmental damage and pollution extend beyond military zones, threatening agricultural land, freshwater habitats and interconnected ecosystems.
Sentinel-2's own classification of the ground, from 21 October 2025 to 23 October 2026, is below the map: green is vegetated ground, yellow open ground.
